description: A man in a flat cap and work clothes leans over a stack of wooden crates inside a hangar at night and hoists the top one. Behind him, a propeller-driven twin-engine plane sits on a lit tarmac. A dark pickup truck on the left has a second worker loading a crate into its bed, and an open box truck is on the right. The front crate carries a stamped wheat-sheaf emblem. The style is a loose oil-painting look with visible brushwork, the cues suggest the 1930s to 1940s, and I see no legible letters, no frame and nothing graphic. The painting runs edge to edge.
